introduction.en: GPT Image 2 is OpenAI's image generation and editing model, exposed through APIPod's primary official-route public ID. It supports prompt-driven generation and reference-image editing in the same asynchronous workflow. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2 是 OpenAI 的图片生成与编辑模型，APIPod 通过主官方路由公开 ID 提供该能力，同一套异步工作流同时支持提示词生图和参考图编辑。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2 Lite is APIPod's cost-oriented routing variant for GPT Image 2 rather than a separate OpenAI model. It uses the shared generation and editing contract with lower-cost configured channels. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2-lite. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2 Lite 是 APIPod 面向低成本通道提供的 GPT Image 2 路由版本，并非独立的 OpenAI 模型；它沿用统一的图片生成与编辑契约。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2-lite，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2 Fast is APIPod's latency-oriented routing variant for GPT Image 2 rather than a separate OpenAI model. It keeps the shared generation and editing request shape while favoring faster configured channels. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2-fast. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2 Fast 是 APIPod 面向低延迟通道提供的 GPT Image 2 路由版本，并非独立的 OpenAI 模型；它沿用统一的图片生成与编辑请求结构。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2-fast，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Nano Banana 2 is Google's general-purpose Gemini image generation and editing model, balancing fast generation with instruction following, text rendering, and subject consistency across reference images. In APIPod, the public model ID is nano-banana-2. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Nano Banana 2 是 Google Gemini 图片系列的通用型生成与编辑模型，重点兼顾生成速度、指令理解、文字渲染和多张参考图下的主体一致性。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 nano-banana-2，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Nano Banana 2 Lite is the ultra-fast, low-cost tier of Google's Nano Banana 2 image generation family. In APIPod, the public model ID is nano-banana-2-lite. It generates and edits images at 1K resolution only, supports the ten standard aspect ratios (banner ratios 1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1 are exclusive to nano-banana-2), accepts text and up to 14 image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Nano Banana 2 Lite 是 Google Nano Banana 2 图片生成系列的极速低价档位。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 nano-banana-2-lite，仅支持 1K 分辨率与十种常规宽高比（1:4、4:1、1:8、8:1 横幅比例为 nano-banana-2 独占）；接受文本与最多 14 张参考图输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Nano Banana Pro is Google's high-quality Gemini image model for complex creative work, with an emphasis on multimodal reasoning, real-world knowledge, precise text rendering, multi-image composition, and high-resolution output. In APIPod, the public model ID is nano-banana-pro. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Nano Banana Pro 是 Google Gemini 图片系列中面向复杂创作的高质量模型，强调多模态推理、现实世界知识、精细文字渲染、多图融合和高分辨率输出。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 nano-banana-pro，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 4.5 is ByteDance's text-to-image model for prompt-faithful composition, detailed visual styles, and text rendering. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-v4.5. It supports text-to-image, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 4.5 是字节跳动的文生图模型，重点提升提示词遵循、画面构图、视觉风格和文字渲染能力。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-v4.5，支持文生图；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 4.5 Edit is ByteDance's reference-image editing model, designed to preserve subjects and fine details while following transformation instructions across one or more source images. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-v4.5-edit. It supports image generation and editing, accepts image and text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 4.5 Edit 是字节跳动的参考图编辑模型，适合在一张或多张源图片之间保持主体和细节，并按提示词完成可控修改。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-v4.5-edit，支持图片生成与编辑；接受图片、文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Lite is APIPod's efficiency-oriented text-to-image route in the Seedream 5 family, intended for prompt-driven generation with flexible high-resolution output. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-lite. It supports text-to-image, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Lite 是 APIPod 在 Seedream 5 系列中开放的效率型文生图路由，面向提示词驱动和灵活的高分辨率图片生成。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-lite，支持文生图；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Lite Edit is APIPod's efficiency-oriented Seedream 5 route for reference-guided image editing and subject-consistent transformations. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-lite-edit. It supports image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Lite Edit 是 APIPod 在 Seedream 5 系列中开放的效率型图片编辑路由，用于参考图引导和保持主体一致性的图像修改。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-lite-edit，支持图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 2.7 Image is Alibaba's text-to-image model with an optional reasoning stage for interpreting prompts and planning composition before rendering. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan2.7-image. It supports text-to-image, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 2.7 Image 是阿里的文生图模型，可通过可选的生成前推理理解提示词并规划构图。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan2.7-image，支持文生图；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 2.7 Image Edit is Alibaba's instruction-based image editing model for controlled changes that preserve the source structure and principal subjects. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan2.7-image-edit. It supports image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 2.7 Image Edit 是阿里的指令式图片编辑模型，用于在保留原图结构和主要主体的同时完成可控修改。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan2.7-image-edit，支持图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 2.7 Image Pro is the high-resolution text-to-image route in APIPod's Wan 2.7 image family, with a 4K output tier for detailed or large-format assets. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan2.7-image-pro. It supports text-to-image, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 2.7 Image Pro 是 APIPod Wan 2.7 图片系列中的高分辨率文生图路由，提供 4K 输出档位，适合细节丰富或大尺寸素材。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan2.7-image-pro，支持文生图；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 2.7 Image Pro Edit is the quality-oriented editing route in APIPod's Wan 2.7 image family, combining reference images with text instructions for high-fidelity changes. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan2.7-image-pro-edit. It supports image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 2.7 Image Pro Edit 是 APIPod Wan 2.7 图片系列中的质量优先编辑路由，通过参考图片和文本指令完成高保真修改。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan2.7-image-pro-edit，支持图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Fast is a fast-generation route based on Google Veo 3.1. It supports text or first/last-frame image guidance and can generate video with audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-fast. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Fast 基于 Google Veo 3.1，属于快速生成路由，支持文本或首尾帧图片引导，并可生成带音频的视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-fast，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Fast 4K is a fast-generation route based on Google Veo 3.1. It supports text or first/last-frame image guidance and can generate video with audio, with this public ID targeting 4K output. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-fast-4k. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Fast 4K 基于 Google Veo 3.1，属于快速生成路由，支持文本或首尾帧图片引导，并可生成带音频的视频；该公开 ID 以 4K 输出为目标。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-fast-4k，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Fast Ref is Google Veo 3.1's multi-reference video route, using up to three subject or style images to guide character, lighting, and color consistency. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-fast-ref. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Fast Ref 是 Google Veo 3.1 的多参考图视频路由，可使用最多 3 张主体或风格参考图控制角色、光线和色调的一致性。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-fast-ref，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Quality is a quality-focused route based on Google Veo 3.1. It supports text or first/last-frame image guidance and can generate video with audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-quality. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Quality 基于 Google Veo 3.1，属于质量优先路由，支持文本或首尾帧图片引导，并可生成带音频的视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-quality，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Quality 4K is a quality-focused route based on Google Veo 3.1. It supports text or first/last-frame image guidance and can generate video with audio, with this public ID targeting 4K output. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-quality-4k. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Quality 4K 基于 Google Veo 3.1，属于质量优先路由，支持文本或首尾帧图片引导，并可生成带音频的视频；该公开 ID 以 4K 输出为目标。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-quality-4k，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Text to Video is a standard route that turns text instructions into video without requiring source media. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 文生视频是标准路由，根据文本指令生成视频，不要求提供源媒体。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Image to Video is a standard route that animates a required first-frame image and can use an optional last frame where the public schema allows it. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 图生视频是标准路由，以必填首帧图片生成视频，并在公开 schema 允许时使用可选尾帧。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-i2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Reference to Video is a standard route that uses reference images, video, or audio to guide subjects, motion, visual style, and sound. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-r2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text, image and video inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 参考生视频是标准路由，使用参考图片、视频或音频引导主体、动作、视觉风格和声音。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-r2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片、视频输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Fast Text to Video is a lower-latency route that turns text instructions into video without requiring source media. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-fast-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 Fast 文生视频是低延迟路由，根据文本指令生成视频，不要求提供源媒体。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-fast-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Fast Image to Video is a lower-latency route that animates a required first-frame image and can use an optional last frame where the public schema allows it. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-fast-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text, image, audio and video inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 Fast 图生视频是低延迟路由，以必填首帧图片生成视频，并在公开 schema 允许时使用可选尾帧。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-fast-i2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片、音频、视频输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Fast Reference to Video is a lower-latency route that uses reference images, video, or audio to guide subjects, motion, visual style, and sound. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-fast-r2v. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video and video-to-video, accepts text, image, audio and video inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 Fast 参考生视频是低延迟路由，使用参考图片、视频或音频引导主体、动作、视觉风格和声音。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-fast-r2v，支持文生视频、图生视频、视频到视频；接受文本、图片、音频、视频输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Grok Imagine is a text-to-video route in xAI's Grok Imagine video family, intended for short clips with coherent motion and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Grok Imagine 是 xAI Grok Imagine 视频系列的文生视频路由，用于生成带连贯运动和同步音频的短视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 grok-imagine-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Grok Imagine is a image-to-video route in xAI's Grok Imagine video family, intended for short clips with coherent motion and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Grok Imagine 是 xAI Grok Imagine 视频系列的图生视频路由，用于生成带连贯运动和同步音频的短视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 grok-imagine-i2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Grok Imagine 1.5 Fast is a fast route for longer clips and multiple reference images in xAI's Grok Imagine video family, intended for short clips with coherent motion and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-1.5-fast. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Grok Imagine 1.5 Fast 是 xAI Grok Imagine 视频系列的面向较长片段和多参考图的快速路由，用于生成带连贯运动和同步音频的短视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 grok-imagine-1.5-fast，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Grok Imagine 1.5 Preview is a preview route that requires one source image in xAI's Grok Imagine video family, intended for short clips with coherent motion and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-1.5-preview. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Grok Imagine 1.5 Preview 是 xAI Grok Imagine 视频系列的要求单张源图片的预览路由，用于生成带连贯运动和同步音频的短视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 grok-imagine-1.5-preview，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Sora 2 VIP is APIPod's official-provider routing ID for Sora 2. Its public contract supports 4-, 8-, or 12-second clips and an optional first-frame image. In APIPod, the public model ID is sora-2-vip. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Sora 2 VIP 是 APIPod 为 Sora 2 提供的官方供应商路由 ID，公开契约支持 4、8、12 秒视频以及可选首帧图片。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 sora-2-vip，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Gemini Omni T2V is APIPod's text-to-video routing mode for the configured Gemini Omni channel. It uses text instructions to create video without requiring reference media. In APIPod, the public model ID is gemini-omni-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Gemini Omni T2V 是 APIPod 为已配置 Gemini Omni 通道提供的文生视频路由模式，仅使用文本指令生成视频，不要求参考素材。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gemini-omni-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Gemini Omni I2V is APIPod's first/last-frame image-to-video routing mode for the configured Gemini Omni channel. It accepts one required first frame and one optional last frame. In APIPod, the public model ID is gemini-omni-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Gemini Omni I2V 是 APIPod 为已配置 Gemini Omni 通道提供的首尾帧图生视频路由模式，要求提供首帧，并可选提供尾帧。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gemini-omni-i2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Gemini Omni R2V is APIPod's reference-to-video routing mode for the configured Gemini Omni channel. It uses one to five reference images to guide subject and visual consistency. In APIPod, the public model ID is gemini-omni-r2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Gemini Omni R2V 是 APIPod 为已配置 Gemini Omni 通道提供的参考生视频路由模式，支持使用 1 至 5 张参考图引导主体和视觉一致性。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gemini-omni-r2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Gemini Omni Extend is APIPod's video extension and editing routing mode for the configured Gemini Omni channel. It requires a source video and can attach up to five reference images. In APIPod, the public model ID is gemini-omni-extend. It supports video-to-video, accepts text, video and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Gemini Omni Extend 是 APIPod 为已配置 Gemini Omni 通道提供的视频续写与编辑路由模式，要求提供源视频，并可附带最多 5 张参考图。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gemini-omni-extend，支持视频到视频；接受文本、视频、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 3.0 Prime Image to Video is the high-speed tier of Alibaba's Wan 3.0 video family that animates a first-frame image and supports last-frame control where exposed, with significantly faster end-to-end generation. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan3.0-prime-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 3.0 Prime 图生视频是阿里 Wan 3.0 视频模型的高速版，将首帧图片生成视频，并在公开契约中支持尾帧控制，端到端生成速度显著提升。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan3.0-prime-i2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 3.0 Prime Reference to Video is the high-speed tier of Alibaba's Wan 3.0 video family that uses image, video, audio, file, or web references to guide generation, with significantly faster end-to-end generation. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan3.0-prime-r2v. It supports image-to-video and video-to-video, accepts text, image, audio, video and file inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 3.0 Prime 参考生视频是阿里 Wan 3.0 视频模型的高速版，使用图片、视频、音频、文件或网页参考素材引导生成，端到端生成速度显著提升。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan3.0-prime-r2v，支持图生视频、视频到视频；接受文本、图片、音频、视频、文件输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 3.0 Prime Text to Video is the high-speed tier of Alibaba's Wan 3.0 video family that creates video directly from text prompts without source media, with significantly faster end-to-end generation. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan3.0-prime-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 3.0 Prime 文生视频是阿里 Wan 3.0 视频模型的高速版，直接根据文本提示词生成视频，不要求源媒体，端到端生成速度显著提升。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan3.0-prime-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。
